page.title: Jɛɲɔgɔnyaw
page.intro: Aw ye aw ka piblisite jatew siri ɲɔgɔn na. Leads minnu bɛ bɔ i ka piblisitew la, olu bɛ se My Leads kɔnɔ u yɛrɛma, ni musaka ni musaka ye lead kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form bɛ taa ni mɔgɔ ye My Leads kɔnɔ, don o don musaka ni musaka lead kelen na, ani lead jogo bɛ ci ka segin LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: A ma sigi sen kan nin sèrwɛri in kan fɔlɔ

banner.connected: LinkedIn bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ. Leads bɛ ka lase sisan - nin ɲɛ in bɛ update kɛ waati dɔɔnin kɔnɔ.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ma sigi sen kan nin sèrwɛri in kan fɔlɔ. Administrateur ka kan ka LinkedIn app ka client ID ni gundo fara a kan.
banner.expired: LinkedIn jɛgɛn waati tɛmɛna, o la, ɲɛminɛbagaw tɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ. Segin ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ walasa ka taa ɲɛ.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn b’a ɲini i fɛ i ka don kokura ka kɔn {{date}} ɲɛ. Aw bɛ segin ka ɲɔgɔn don ɲɔgɔn na sani o ka kɛ walasa ka ɲɛminɛbagaw ka to ka woyo.

connect.title: LinkedIn ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ
connect.intro: I ka don ni LinkedIn jatebɔsɛbɛn ye min bɛ i ka piblisitew ɲɛnabɔ. Leadrat bɛ i ka piblisite jatew dɔrɔn de kalan, Lead Gen Form ɲɛminɛbagaw ani piblisite jatebɔw, ani ka fɛn caman ci i bɛ fɛn minnu wuli i bɛ minnu daminɛ.
connect.need1: Jɔrɔ dɔ LinkedIn piblisite jatebɔsɛbɛn kan (Lajɛbaga walima a sanfɛla).
connect.need2: Jɔrɔ min bɛ sosiyete ɲɛ min bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na (Administrateur, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator walima Analyst) - LinkedIn b’a ɲini a fɛ a ka ɲɛmɔgɔw tila ɲɔgɔn na.
connect.need3: Telefɔni nimɔrɔ ɲininkali dɔ bɛ i ka Lead Gen Forms kan - leads minnu tɛ telefɔni nimɔrɔ ye, olu tɛ se ka fara a kan.

connection.fetchTitle: Aw bɛ ɲɛmɔgɔya ta ka kɛɲɛ ni donw hakɛ ye
connection.fetchHint: Led kura bɛ lajɛ miniti damadɔ o miniti damadɔ ani tile 7 labanw bɛ segin ka lajɛ don o don, o la foyi tɛ tɛmɛ. Aw bɛ nin kɛ ka ɲɛsin ɲɛminɛbagaw ma minnu bɔra sani aw ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ, walima ka waati dɔ lajɛ kokura (fo ka se tile 90 ma a waati kelen na). Leads minnu bɛ Leadrat kɔnɔ kaban, olu bɛ tɛmɛ.

accounts.intro: Leads ni statistics bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ ka bɔ piblisite jatew la minnu bɛ daminɛ yan.
accounts.none: Piblisite jatebɔsɛbɛn si ma sɔrɔ nin LinkedIn jatebɔsɛbɛn in kan. Aw ye jatebɔsɛbɛn jɔyɔrɔ lajɛ LinkedIn Campaign Manager kɔnɔ , o kɔ aw bɛ a kuraya.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: A fɔ LinkedIn ye ko a ɲɛmɔgɔ jumɛn kɛra jigiya lakikaw ye. Ni LinkedIn ɲɛmɔgɔ dɔ sera cogo la i bɛ min sugandi jukɔrɔ, Leadrat b’o fɔ LinkedIn ye , o la i ka kanpaɲi kunnafoniw bɛ ɲɛmɔgɔya jogo jira ani LinkedIn bɛ se ka mɔgɔ caman sɔrɔ i n’a fɔ i ka ɲɛmɔgɔ ɲumanw. LinkedIn lead ID ni email hash kelen dɔrɔn de bɛ ci.
capi.type: Rapport kɛ LinkedIn kan i n’a fɔ
capi.created: Yɛlɛma min dabɔra LinkedIn kan ani karti.
